phase_policies.applies_when: Around 180 seconds, both players have an unknown army posture with heavy technology investment; opponent production is heavy while yours is moderate.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate once more scouting information about opponent's army composition is available; check current resources, supply, and production queues.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech, keep ground defense, avoid early army overcommitment.
phase_policies.target: Increase economy and expansion while continuing technology development; strengthen ground forces as a baseline and maintain a defensive posture.
phase_policies.title: Tech-Focused Economy with Ground Baseline
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a large army before enemy plan is known; avoid neglecting economy or tech for premature aggression.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 240-300 seconds, both players have a ground-oriented macro posture with heavy production and technology; opponent shows ground army with possible pressure.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if opponent shows signs of air transition or significant army push; check current army strength and production capacity.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balance economy, tech, and ground army; keep defenses solid, adapt to enemy moves.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and technology while strengthening ground forces; maintain defensive posture and consider increasing expansion and production.
phase_policies.title: Ground Macro with Heavy Production and Tech
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect defensive positioning while expanding; avoid overextending without scouting for air transitions or large pushes.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 420-540 seconds, both players have ground-oriented macro posture with heavy production and technology; opponent shows siege tanks and marines.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if opponent attempts to break defensive line or transitions to air; check siege tank count and defensive positioning.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Hold position with siege tanks, keep economy growing, prepare for potential air threats.
phase_policies.target: Increase defensive capabilities while strengthening ground forces; maintain economy and expansion, consider adding siege tanks to composition.
phase_policies.title: Defensive Ground Siege with Economy Focus
phase_policies.veto: Do not become passive and allow opponent economic advantage; avoid engaging without proper siege setup.

phase_policies.applies_when: Around 600 seconds, both players have ground-oriented macro posture with heavy production and technology; opponent has moderate air presence with medivacs, your air is light.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if opponent commits heavily to air or if defensive positioning needs adjustment; check anti-air capabilities and medivac count.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Keep ground army strong, add anti-air, stay defensive, adapt to enemy air commitment.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground forces while adding air support or anti-air to counter medivacs; maintain defensive posture and economy.
phase_policies.title: Ground Strength with Air Support
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect air defense; avoid overcommitting to air without maintaining ground core.
